latest_release.body:
Many many many changes it's been 3 years (wtf)
Primarily localization changes and fixes

## What's Changed
* Add Scoop installation reference by @sitiom in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/173
* Fix watermark contrast by @ahmubashshir in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/177
* Add support for fake transparency through XShape. by @jcontoso in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/175
* Update i18n.c by @Pbnnr in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/180
* Added pl_PL by @ameoverflow in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/181
* Update i18n.c by @Luca090902 in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/183
* make: Implement optional deps support by @ahmubashshir in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/188
* [CI] Cutting edge actions by @AHOHNMYC in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/196
* Add Spanish translation. by @zSnails in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/197
* Add tr_TR localization by @betelqeyza in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/192
* Lets all love __info__ by @AHOHNMYC in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/193
* Append i18n for zh_CN zh_TW zh_HK by @SunsetMkt in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/200
* Fixed fr_FR translation and added french canadian translation by @alizeegagnon in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/201
* Fix French "m$" preset by @therollingkitten in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/204
* Added hungarian translation. by @miklosakos in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/206
* Add czech and slovak localization by @CodyMarkix in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/208
* sv_SE localization by @thisiselias in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/209
* add two letter language code fallback by @Ruby-Dragon in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/213
* Remove offsets by @Ruby-Dragon in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/215
* fix(i18n): removed period in chinese strings for better readibility by @olivertzeng in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/210
* Fix the dutch (nl_nl) translation by @J-Bollie in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/218
* fix(i18n): segmentation fault by @wangLshuai in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/221
* i18n: add catalan by @saeziae in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/233
* add en_CA as locale by @Ruby-Dragon in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/232
* Fix crash on Wayland due to uninitialised variable by @plingbang in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/228
* Fix Dutch locale grammar + add Dutch diss text by @Thulinma in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/235
* fix(i18n): Add missing period in Chinese translations by @fQwQf in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/238
* feat: use pangocairo to handle font fallbacks by @OriginCode in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/239
* nix: add pango to dependencies by @algorithmiker in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/242
* Fix lang detection error caused by lang hint by @Trenclik in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/245
* Add Vietnamese localization strings to i18n.c by @SITUVNgcd in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/247
* Add Ukrainian translation by @r0ddty in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/250
* Add Korean translation by @tmvkrpxl0 in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/255
* fix start daemon by @zedzhen in https://github.com/MrGlockenspiel/activate-linux/pull/258
